errors: First SAWS implementation dropped below the envelope while loading (reload line applied during forward loading) and cut unloading by the reload line; both found by the OpenSees comparison and fixed before any wall result.
First wall solver (Newton on max-norm residual) failed after the peak (residual 11 F0); replaced by a PD-shifted Newton with a line search on the incremental potential before the experiment ran.

doc_friction.issue: The bracketed pkill hint is not enough: the hook also refuses the command if the unbracketed name appears anywhere else in the same line (e.g. a later script invocation); used TaskStop / kill <pid> instead.
Plain python3 lacks numpy; pyenv.py returned /usr/bin/python3.13 at once, which is worth saying up front for this image.

deviations.why: The plan described SAWS's rules in one line; implementing them exactly needed two rules the description left implicit (stay on the envelope while loading forward; reload on the unloading line until the pinching line).
deviations.did: Matched OpenSees SAWSMaterial exactly (2e-13) and recorded both rules in the LOG result and the module docstring.
deviations.result: H93 held exactly; no registered hypothesis or threshold was changed.

deviations.why: loops.json was 645 KB; added rounding to 0.01 mm / 0.01 FU after the run.
deviations.did: Applied the identical rounding function to the produced file instead of re-running 70 min.
